empty.purpose: Says All music holds no tracks.
empty.where: All music screen, when the scan found no tracks and nothing is searched.

search.purpose: Label and placeholder of the search box.
search.where: All music screen, search input at the top.

trackCount_one.purpose: How many tracks All music lists, when it lists one. Same wording as the Library's count (library:trackCount_one).
trackCount_one.where: All music screen, above the track table.

trackCount_other.purpose: How many tracks All music lists (all of them, or those the search and the filters leave). Same wording as the Library's count (library:trackCount_other).
trackCount_other.where: All music screen, above the track table.

add.purpose: Button that adds a track to the Library.
add.where: All music table, Library column, on a track not yet in the Library.

inLibrary.purpose: Says a track is already in the Library.
inLibrary.where: All music table, Library column, on a track already in it.

matchNotConfirmed.purpose: Reason a track can't be added to the Library: one of its files is the probable match of a rekordbox track, and that match can't be confirmed yet.
matchNotConfirmed.where: All music list, Library column, beside a greyed-out Add to Library button.

lowBitrate.title.purpose: Question asked before a low-bitrate file is added to the Library (owner decision 2026-10-10).
lowBitrate.title.where: All music, warning box above the list, after "Add to Library" on a track whose file has the low bitrate finding.

lowBitrate.detail.purpose: Says why the add is being questioned: the file has a low bitrate, and such files are better left out.
lowBitrate.detail.where: All music, warning box above the list, under the question.
lowBitrate.detail.approved: This file has a low bitrate ({{kbps}} kbps)

lowBitrate.addAnyway.purpose: Adds the track to the Library despite the warning.
lowBitrate.addAnyway.where: All music, warning box, first button.

lowBitrate.cancel.purpose: Closes the warning and adds nothing.
lowBitrate.cancel.where: All music, warning box, second button (focused first).
